newsitem.title: INDIA: India's SBI GDR issue cleared - official.
newsitem.headline: India's SBI GDR issue cleared - official.

text.p: The Indian government has granted permission to the State Bank of India to issue global depositary receipts (GDRs) of up to $500 million dollars, but the bank plans to raise only $400 million, an official said on Friday.
"Permission has been given to issue GDRs for $500 million but we are going in for an issue of $400 million only," the bank official said.
"The issue will be for $350 million with a greenshoe option for $50 million."
The roadshows for the issue begin on September 21, he said.
